entities.name: Extended CAG information list
entities.description: An information element that the network may include to assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the CAG information list at the UE side.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE that supports Extended CAG information list functionality.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may include the Extended CAG information list IE.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: The CAG information list stored at the UE side that can be assigned or deleted.

relations.description: The network may include the Extended CAG information list IE in messages.
The Extended CAG information list IE can assign a new CAG information list to the UE.
The Extended CAG information list IE can delete the CAG information list at the UE side.
The UE must support Extended CAG information list for the network to include this IE.
